summary: Phase 16.1 regression pass (Global theme rewrite + ModernDashboard + mobile bottom-nav). Frontend: all 26 documented data-testids on ModernDashboard render, all theme variables apply globally (body bg rgb(238,241,250)=#EEF1FA, sidebar rgb(15,29,58)=#0F1D3A, body font-family='Inter, ...') on /patients, /patients/list, /billing, /reports — no theme regression detected. Front-Office Snapshot navigation 3/3 pass. Alerts navigation 3/3 pass. Quick Actions navigation 5/6 pass (qa-ha-sale drops '?quick=1' query param — see MINOR issue). qa-new-appt opens BookAppointmentModal (data-testid=book-apt-modal). Mobile bottom-nav renders at 390x844 and all 5 tabs (bnav-home/sched/patients/billing/reports) navigate correctly; mobile-fab-book is visible. Patients list (50 rows, search input) and Billing (table + Invoices tab) still fully functional. Auth session survives page reload (httpOnly cookie ok). Backend smoke: 7/7 dashboard endpoints (/appointments, /patients, /sessions, /billing/invoices, /users, /ha/service-tickets?status=ready_for_pickup, /ha/accessory-stock?low_stock_only=true) return 200 with owner token. Zero new console errors — one pre-existing React hydration warning about <span> nested inside <option> (unrelated to Phase 16.1, present on /patients/list).

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking qa-ha-sale navigates to /ha/fittings without the '?quick=1' query param — the dashboard source correctly calls navigate('/ha/fittings?quick=1'), but /ha/fittings appears to strip / redirect the query on mount. Verify at the /ha/fittings route file (initial useEffect or Route redirect). Not a blocker — user still lands on the correct page — but the 'quick add' modal may not auto-open as designed.

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Not introduced by Phase 16.1 (unrelated to theme rewrite). Consider replacing the span-in-option with a data attribute + parent styling.

action_items: MINOR: Inspect /ha/fittings route to see why '?quick=1' query param is dropped when arriving from qa-ha-sale. Likely a useEffect that does navigate('/ha/fittings', { replace: true }) or a similar canonicalization. Should preserve searchParams on mount.
OPTIONAL: Fix the pre-existing React hydration warning on /patients/list — a <span> is nested inside an <option>. Replace with text content + a data-* attribute or a class on the <option>.

OPTIONAL: Consider adding a mobile-only fallback for the mobile FAB so its click is not intercepted by the sticky bottom-nav overlay in some scroll positions (currently z-30 vs bottom-nav's implicit z-index; observed one flaky non-open in the test run, but re-inspection confirmed the button exists and its handler is the same as the passing qa-new-appt).
critical_code_review_comments: ModernDashboard.jsx is 894 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold recommended in the code-review guidelines. Consider extracting KpiCard, UTile, AttentionStrip, WeekLineChart, and the Front-Office row into a components/ subdirectory to keep the top-level dashboard concise.

AppShell uses inline style={ background: '#0F1D3A' } / '#EEF1FA' — these hex values duplicate the CSS variables --audinexa-bg / navy. Prefer `style={ background: 'var(--audinexa-bg)' }` (or a utility class) so a future theme tweak requires only editing index.css.
BookAppointmentModal uses data-testid='book-apt-modal' — the review request expected 'book-appointment-modal'. Not a bug but naming is inconsistent with other modules; consider aliasing.
The 'qa-ha-sale' URL query drop is a genuine app bug worth root-causing in the target route rather than papering over in the dashboard.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 16.1 (Global theme rewrite + ModernDashboard redesign + mobile bottom nav) is fully green. Only one MINOR issue: /ha/fittings strips the '?quick=1' query param — worth fixing in that route file. Note: BookAppointmentModal's testid is 'book-apt-modal', NOT 'book-appointment-modal' (review-request wording was slightly off). Backend smoke tests for dashboard endpoints live at /app/backend/tests/test_iter37_dashboard_smoke.py — reuse for future dashboard regression.
rca of the issue: qa-ha-sale query-param loss: ModernDashboard.jsx L743 correctly calls navigate('/ha/fittings?quick=1'). Investigation should focus on the /ha/fittings route component — likely a useEffect(() => navigate(pathname, {replace:true})) or a route-level redirect that discards searchParams. Fix: read/preserve location.search in the target component before any redirect.
